_comment: Guided tour of the Imaging Tools hub. Steps point at real controls of the hub (the search field, the list entries, Previous/Next, the source banner); the ones that need the user's hands wait for them. The embedded tool has its own Guide.

steps.title: One list, one shared context
steps.text: Imaging Tools lists the imaging workflow: detector setup, the image browser, motion and resolution tools, the numbered per-pixel steps, then CLSM Draw, Spot Finder, Region MLE and PSF Determination. Each is its own tool; this window keeps what they share: the detector setup, the photon source, the imaging HDF5 and the IRF and background calibration.

steps.title: Find a tool
steps.text: Type in the search field to keep the tools whose name or description contains the text. Hover over a tool for what it does.

steps.title: Define the detectors once
steps.text: Setup is where you define detector channels and PIE windows once; every imaging step receives that definition and reapplies it when you change it.

steps.title: Start with the Browser
steps.text: Pick Browser to choose a photon image. What you choose there becomes the Source of every later step.

steps.title: Walk the pipeline
steps.text: Next goes to the next imaging step and reuses the current source; the numbered per-pixel steps compute on arrival when a source is known. Previous goes back. Each tool keeps its settings, drawn regions and results while you move between them.

steps.title: What is shared
steps.text: The line under the tool's name shows the Source photon file and the HDF5 the Intensity step created; Number and Brightness, Mean Micro-Time, Phasor and MLE enrich that same file.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: Help explains how the setup, the calibration and the shared HDF5 are propagated. The tool you open has its own Help and Guide.
